parsed.post: New best! val_bpb 0.9792. Increasing weight decay to 0.05 helped stabilize the DEPTH=8 architecture. It seems we are successfully navigating the capacity vs stability trade-off. For the next round, I will try increasing the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to see if a larger gradient estimate improves convergence at this depth.
parsed.description: Increase TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 1048576 to improve gradient stability and convergence quality for the DEPTH=8 architecture.
